summary: Reproduced at c8ed45c6152f. A fully EXL3 BlockSparseMLP (4 experts, top 2; is_quantized True, so one token takes the fused path) called on one token with activate_all_experts=True raised RuntimeError 'mgemm: too many indices for tensor batch' at exllamav3/modules/block_sparse_mlp.py:390: routing produced 4 indices but the fused buffers hold num_experts_per_tok = 2 entries.
what_ran: repro.py generates a tiny random 1-layer MixtralForCausalLM (4 experts, top 2) with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tokenizer files, quantizes it to 4 bpw EXL3 with the repository's converter at this commit, constructs BlockSparseMLP with MixtralModel's arguments, computes an all-expert reference on a 2-token batch (ordinary path), then calls forward on one token with activate_all_experts=True, on physical GPU 1.
limits: Synthetic weights; BlockSparseMLP constructed directly. Default routing only.

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny MixtralForCausalLM generated by repro.py (tokenizer from Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct), quantized at the tested commit
